# Slide Indicator

Indicate that there is more content available and how many items there are left to cycle or scroll through.<br />
See [Slide Indicator guidelines<i className="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/slide-indicator/design/)

<Source code="import { SlideIndicator } from &#x22;@airbus/components-react&#x22;" />

<Primary />

<Controls />

* To use as a controlled component, use `Selected` and `onStepClick` together
* Any other props supplied will be provided to the root elements
* For details on CSS styles, see [CSS implementation](https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system/blob/develop/packages/styles/src/elements/ProgressIndicator/index.ts)

### Overflow

The maximum of visible steps is 7.<br />
When there are more available, it will be indicated with smaller steps and animation.

<Canvas of={SlideIndicatorStories.Overflow} />
